== Summary ==
An anthropologist's delight. Pizza boxes, torn cards from an Iron Man event and Austin Powers CCG wrappers fill a hefty bag at DecipherCon. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]], [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
